info.description:
REST API for the PrediFi prediction-market platform built on Stellar/Soroban.

Versioning: `/api/v1` is active. Every `/api/<version>` response carries an `API-Version` header; deprecated versions and operations add `Deprecation`, `Sunset` and `Link` headers and are listed by `GET /api/v1`. See docs/API_VERSIONING_POLICY.md.

Errors: every failure uses the versioned error envelope (`ErrorResponse`) with a stable `code`, a safe `message`, `request_id` (also in the `x-request-id` header) and `retryable`.
